name: Abbey Church of Saint-Savin sur Gartempe
description: Rising above the Gartempe river in western France's Vienne department, this abbey church is often nicknamed the "Romanesque Sistine Chapel." Its fame comes from the painted walls and vaults inside, created in the 11th and 12th centuries. Remarkably well preserved, they cover the church in colourful scenes, making it one of the finest collections of medieval murals you can walk into.
